dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to determine the vegetative and generative phenology along the growing season of different vegetation types, for the purpose of correlating it with seasonal Net Ecosystem Production (NEP), calculated from CO2 fluxes measured with static chambers, as well as NDVI values in the same vegetation plots. Phenology was determined in 9 plots situated in the three main vegetation types: polar desert (PD), mid-moisture tundra (MM) and wet sedge meadow (WS), as well as in 12 of the International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) plots.
dct_title_s: 2010 Assessment of Vegetation Phenology, Cape Bounty
